# GENERATED by tools/gen.py from tools/inline_editor/common/scripted_effects/rn_inline_reset.txt - edit the source.
# Restore a country's name: remove the player-given name through the single carrier
# (rn_country_name_carrier_clear). The country shows the game's current name again (its cosmetic
# tag, or its base name); flag and colour are the game's. A reset uses the same rename cooldown as
# a new name (decision 2026-10-14): refused while it runs, and started by the reset. Every
# effect repeats the checks of the matching Apply, because the game does not repeat a button's
# enabled trigger before its effect.

# Own country, from the politics editor (rn_ip_country_*). Scope: the player's country (ROOT).
rn_inline_country_reset = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = ROOT
			is_ai = no
			has_country_flag = rn_ip_country_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_ip_leader_open }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_ip_party_neutrality_open }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_open }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input }
			check_variable = { rn_ip_country_target^num = 1 }
			is_in_array = { array = rn_ip_country_target value = THIS }
			rn_cn_has_custom = yes
			NOT = { rn_ip_cooldown_active_country = yes }
		}
		rn_country_name_carrier_clear = yes
		rn_ip_cooldown_start_country = yes
		rn_inline_pair_cancel_country = yes
	}
}

# Subject, from the subject editor's Country tab. Scope: the player (ROOT); the target is the pinned
# rn_sub_target, checked like an Apply (rn_sub_may_edit, one pin, the Country editor open).
rn_sub_reset_country = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 20 }
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_field = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			has_country_flag = rn_sub_open_country
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_open }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input }
			has_variable = rn_sub_target
			check_variable = { rn_sub_target_arr^num = 1 }
			var:rn_sub_target = { rn_sub_may_edit = yes rn_cn_has_custom = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:rn_sub_target = { rn_ip_cooldown_active_country = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 11 }
		}
		else = {
			var:rn_sub_target = { rn_country_name_carrier_clear = yes rn_ip_cooldown_start_country = yes }
			rn_sub_close = yes
		}
	}
	rn_cv1_status_record = yes
}
